# model.getModule

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.5.0</span></div>

Return module information.

```lua
model.getModule(Index)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Index` | integer | yes |  |

## Returns

module

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local module = model.getModule(0)
```
